description: Small and medium food processing units — dairy products, ready-to-eat foods, fruit and vegetable processing, bakery, spices. Typical Indian clusters: Anand and Vadodara (Gujarat), Krishnagiri (Tamil Nadu), Solan (Himachal Pradesh), Kanpur (Uttar Pradesh). Refrigeration and steam are dominant energy consumers.

unit_processes.name: Refrigeration and Cold Storage
unit_processes.notes: Dominant electricity consumer. Includes chillers, cold rooms, blast freezers, chilled water loops. Ammonia or HFC refrigerants.

unit_processes.name: Steam Generation (Boiler for Pasteurization, Cleaning, Cooking)
unit_processes.notes: Dominant thermal-energy user. Fuel is typically diesel, LPG, briquettes or biomass depending on scale.

unit_processes.name: Processing (Mixing, Pasteurization, Homogenization, Cooking)
unit_processes.notes: Direct process heat delivered from boiler; motors for mixing and pumping.

unit_processes.name: Cleaning-in-Place (CIP) and Sanitation
unit_processes.notes: Hot water and steam for washing tanks and lines between batches. Water-intensive.

unit_processes.name: Packaging (Filling, Sealing, Labelling)
unit_processes.notes: Motors and compressors for filling machines; small heat sealers.

unit_processes.name: Utilities (Compressed Air, Lighting, HVAC)
unit_processes.notes: Compressed air is often significant; production floors need bright, cool ambient conditions.

activities_expected.description: From DISCOM electricity bill (dominant for refrigeration)
Diesel for boiler / DG set backup

sources: BEE Food Processing Cluster Energy Efficiency Programme
Confederation of Indian Food Trade and Industry (CIFTI) benchmarks
Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI) reports
NIFTEM (National Institute of Food Technology) technical reports
